scientific_integrity: Reduced projective rank-one locus only; arbitrary characteristic different from two for geometry and odd prime powers for point counts and rational orbits. Original weight-zero operator equation verified directly. Complex classification of all operators credited to Pei–Bai–Guo (2013), not claimed new. Historical publication priority provisional.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify rank zero, rank two, rank three, characteristic-two Rota–Baxter operators, or the potentially nonreduced polynomial-equation scheme; singular locus is stated set-theoretically. Finite tests do not prove infinite claims.
title: Two-component geometry and exact rational orbits of rank-one Rota–Baxter operators on \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\)
